items.title: My take in @DailyCaller on DISRUPTIONS caused by Trump's war of choice on Iran: “The U.S.-Israeli war of choice against Iran has brought the bond vigilantes out of hibernation and sent interest rates higher. At present, 35% of all personal income tax revenue is consumed by interest payments on America’s debt. That percentage is destined to rise.”
